name: @breadboard/ui-tars-adapter
description: First-party Breadboard-owned adapter for Agent TARS. Loopback-only and secret-gated, with isolated-browser control by default and explicitly approved actual-desktop control. Breadboard remains the sole authorization plane.
//dependencies: @agent-tars/core@0.3.0 is the isolated-browser runtime. @ui-tars/sdk and @ui-tars/operator-nut-js@1.2.3 are the matching official actual-desktop runtime and Windows native operator. Native desktop dependencies are imported only after a desktop-session approval. The published @agent-infra/browser (0.2.2) uses Browser.create({launchOrConnect}) with pptrBrowser/wsEndpoint. All upstream integration remains isolated behind RuntimeClient. `react` is a transitive peer of @agent-infra/browser (via valtio/react).
